p = (df.pivot_table(index='job_code',
                    columns='file_type',
                    values='cnt',
                    aggfunc='sum',
                    fill_value=0))

# job_codes where original count == review count
same_jobcodes = p.index[p.get('original', 0).eq(p.get('review', 0))].tolist()

# number of such job_codes
n_same = len(same_jobcodes)

print(same_jobcodes)
print(n_same)
